title: synthesis result.json contract
description: Complete contract for <module>/Design/synthesis/result.json. On status=pass, stage_specific.requirements[] one verdict per requirements.json row synthesis judges. On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below): the one-line cause, which on a run that produced nothing gradeable is all there is. A verdict carries the measurement behind it in its own `measured`, so nothing else has to travel beside it.

fix_owner.description: Repair stage supported by the evidence: this stage or a transitive input producer, checked by the scheduler. Omit when attribution is unresolved.

requirements.description: One verdict per requirement assigned to this stage. Supported numerical targets are computed from reports; other judgments are supplied through finalize --requirements.
